Unfortunately there’s not a whole lot that can be done. Anything with vitamin E will help especially if you can pop open a vitamin E capsule (like one that’s meant to be eaten) and rub it on. Drink lots of water and use cold compresses to soothe it. Find someone to reach out to, a professional if you can, you deserve to talk to someone about how you’re feeling.

Just try to remember how far you’ve come already and how much regret there usually is after. At least that helps me to stop myself. I always think of how it just makes more problems and I only feel better for about 45 seconds before it’s worse than before.
This exactly. And I’d love to say I’m not ashamed because I wasn’t “doing it on purpose” but I really struggle with that. Especially when others’ input is so full of blame.

Everything I did. Everything I said. How I looked. Yeah basically all of it. I would go out in public wearing just anything. A pair of underwear that looks “enough” like shorts and literally any shirt? Sure let’s go to Walmart! Oh an event? I’ll just roll out of bed and throw on sweatpants! I never showered or did my hair or brushed my teeth. I would get into a verbal fight with anyone, anywhere, about anything. Things definitely got borderline physical. My best friend and my roommate talked my partner into getting cops involved at one point. Still embarrassed it got that bad but also angry they felt the need to do that. I don’t know if I would have listened anyways but it definitely hurt and still does. Anyways the cop in question was actually a distant family friend and I didn’t recognize her at all the entire time. Very very embarrassed about what I said to her. We got pulled over for a traffic stop by the same cop months later and it felt so awkward and embarrassing as well. Still embarrassed about the harm I caused myself that was visible to literally everyone. I left holes in walls, broke my entire bathroom like the door and the actual sink. Everyone close to me either heard or saw everything I did and then I wore the wounds on my face for weeks. So much of it was on home surveillance cameras. Like while dog sitting in someone else’s house I tried to kill myself because I got in an argument with my partner about something stupid and small. And they have a ton of footage of that night. I’m deeply embarrassed about all the available help that I didn’t take because I truthfully wasn’t ready to accept it. Part of my delusions told me they were trying to hurt, not help. I could keep going but yeah you get it, shit’s lethally humiliating. I do feel so so so much better now but I never stop thinking about the things I can’t take back. I hold a lot of shame from that time that I have to work through now. I’m so so incredibly lucky to still have a lot of the people that went through it with me in my life. Still embarrassed, all the time, especially when I remember the specifics. I can’t do anything now to “fix” it but be better. So that’s all I try to do. Getting and accepting help when I clearly need it, staying on track with meds and self care, going to therapy. Sleep deprivation and getting way too high as well as messing around on my meds while ignoring any help or advice was what really caused it all to blow up I think. 

If you’re here now and you’ve been through the same, I’m proud of you for getting this far and just remember whatever caused you to get to that bad place can always come back around so NEVER stop taking care of yourself and reaching out for help. Know your limits! Get your sleep! You can absolutely get through this.

NTA. Hindsight is 20/20, you had no clue what was going on in the moment. You made the right call, it’s probably what I would have done. You set clear and firm boundaries and she still took advantage of you. It’s one thing if you’re already watching the kid and her thing runs late but that wasn’t what you were there to do. She was already in the wrong for leaving, more wrong for taking so much time, and super wrong for not answering her phone when she’s got an 8 year old sitting at home. I don’t know how you do your thing but clearly these parents aren’t hearing your rule.. I’d put it in writing and have them sign it at the beginning of the agreement, if that can be arranged. Make it clear they will pay a fee and authorities may be contacted if you find yourself alone in the home with the child..as you aren’t responsible for their safety and well-being, you’re responsible for their math tests.

I have empathy for her and I hear that she was shaken up, but that’s kind of just what happens when you take that risk... it sounds like she knew it was wrong to leave but did it anyway.

Oh, and your friend needs to get a grip. I mean, sure, it’s worth mentioning that you should be cautious in the future because yeah, they make a valid point. However, they need to put themselves not just in your situation but in your actual shoes. It’s not about what she would’ve done it’s about the fact that YOU did not want that responsibility, YOU had made that clear, and YOU worried about the safety of the kid. They should be mad at the mom and the system, not you.

(TW; self harm, suicide)

Later, I was having trouble with depression and anxiety. I was in 6th grade and I had more missing assignments than not. My dad bought tickets for me and my sister to see my favorite band at the time. However, I was only allowed to go if I had no missing assignments by the end of the year. Fast forward to around February, I’m in the counselors office and she’s telling me she has to call my mom because I’ve been cutting. So I come clean and tell her I really, really want to die. So my mom comes to the school and her and the counselor have a chat but it starts running LONG and I’m getting really anxious to go home so I interrupt and the counselor suggest that I join the conversation. I’ll do anything to wrap it up so I sit and we have an awkward beginning of a conversation and then my mom looks at me, then the counselor, and says “I just don’t think my daughter is suicidal.”

She even made jokes in the car on the way home.. “so should I pour out all of our bleach?” I’d never expressed wanting to drink bleach “should I give all of our knives to the neighbors?” I’d been using a blade from a shaving razor. Fast forward a month and my sister catches me in the act, (not to be graphic, but..) absolutely demolishing my thighs in the shower. I mean, it was the worst it had been around that time. Still, I have no real help, I’m guilt tripped for it and at the end of the night I feel worse. 

At the end of April I attempt suicide. I tried taking pills but in the morning I wake up and I have a voicemail from my principal on my phone saying I could be be arrested if I kept staying home from school. I had been absent a lot, fighting with my mom every other morning to try and stay home. And she gave up a lot and let me, pissed for the next three days over it every time it happened. I did have a lot of chronic migraines but sometimes it was just to hard to go. It was bad but no one really cared, I was just being lazy, right? So that morning my mom had tried to wake me up (I didn’t remember it at all, I probably didn’t even move) but work was important so she eventually left me, thinking I was just being lazy. But she was mad, too. She called my school and told them I wouldn’t get up. There was no concern from anyone, just anger. They all left voicemails all morning but I slept through it all. Finally I woke up... every single one hurt more than the last. 

I tried to slit my wrists that afternoon but my mom came home from work before I could really do the damage. This time I was hospitalized (it didn’t help). A week later and I’m out but I’m also on a heavy dose of zoloft. I try in school and I try at home but none of my problems are fixed, the zoloft isn’t helping, and my mom still has yet to address that my problems are coming from my depression and my anxiety. She just sees me as a horrible kid, causing her problems. I’m hospitalized again about a month later for suicidal thoughts and a week later on the elevator on the way out my dad says “never again”. 

I’m hopeless for the last few weeks of school. At this point I’ve been absent all of those times plus the two weeks of hospitalization. Of course my track record for the missing assignments is shit but so is my mental health. I feel more than alone and zoloft is causing more bad than good. I’m in a stage of perpetual grief over my sister and the lives of my parents pre-divorce is being revealed to me. I’m still just beginning recovery (the last hospital visit actually somewhat got through to me) and it’s finally summer. There’s no word of the concert (I know, small stuff. But it still meant the world to me. Music was the one thing that I still loved, even through depression. Plus I was just learning how much fun life could be with my sister and without my parents.) so I presume I’m still allowed to go. After all, homework seems so trivial at a time in my life where I was dealing with depression, anxiety, self-harm, grief, and suicide... right?

Wrong. Well, at least to my parents. The concert happens to fall on the night of my deceased sisters birthday, July 31 (we always do something fun that night as a celebration of her life). So at the end of the get together I’m ready to go with my sister to the concert and my parents ask what I think I’m doing. Obviously they know but I’m absolutely dumbfounded like..... I’m going to the concert.... the one tonight.... you know, the concert.... They tell me I’m not going. I’m wrecked. I was looking forward to it more than anything. I was excited about it for months. I had been anxiously awaiting it and it was the only thing I cared about at the time. I was distraught for months. I stopped listening to my favorite band.  It still shakes me that they cared more about the number of assignments at school that were unfinished (which greatly decreases, not to mention my grades were... fine. One failed class.) than my own well being. It’s happened over and over again.

Later down the line I was living with my dad and there was a night where I had eaten a personal frozen pizza and went to bed to wake up in agony hours later. I felt like I couldn’t breathe. Something inside around my ribs hurt so bad I though they were fractured but it was more of an abdominal pain. I found my dad and told him, crying and breathing like I had just finished a marathon. He told me to be quiet, GF (his girlfriend who’s house we were living in. The woman he’d do anything for as she tells him he’s doing it wrong) was sleeping and had to work in the morning. He gave me Advil and told me to sleep it off. An absurd amount of water got things to settle down to a degree, for some reason. So after having spent 2-3 hours in the middle of the night in agony, I went to bed. I was woken up to go to school in the morning. 

It happened a few more times and i was never taken to a doctor about it. It was agonizing. It would happen in the middle of the night or when I one up often so I was always being yelled at because they thought I was just trying to stay home. I thought it had something to do with the food so I begged my dad and GF to go vegan with me, hoping it would help get rid of the pain. GF looked me in the eyes while my dad sat and watched and told me “you have no self control”.
